Early-Bird Cook.name: Early-Bird Cook
Early-Bird Cook.description:
🍱 You got up at five every day to cook the family's bento before school, rain or shine.

🍳 You can cook a proper meal fast.
⏰ Discipline is a habit for you now.

📈 Grants: Cooking +5, Willpower +5
Early-Bird Cook.traitNarrativeEffects: The character kept a strict morning routine through high school, cooking for the family before class. They cook well, wake early without trying and stick to a routine others give up on.
